model: monotone additive boosted model (depth-1 trees, increasing in every layer); PLOS = 100 x predicted future co-movement = base + sum of layer contributions

descriptions.Q1_residual_corr: Co-movement after removing the market and mid-cap factors (shared stock picking)
descriptions.Q2_factor_similarity: Similarity of exposure to the Nifty 50 and Nifty Midcap 50 factors
descriptions.H1_weighted_overlap: Share of money in the same stocks: sum of min(weight A, weight B)
descriptions.H2_jaccard: Share of stock names held in common (Jaccard)
descriptions.H3_top10_jaccard: Overlap of the top-10 conviction holdings

validation.method: leave-one-scheme-out over pairs; features strictly before the target window
validation.production: v2_monotone_additive: beats v1 and the linear fit; the depth-2 model scores higher but uses layer interactions, so its per-layer contributions could not be shown exactly -- kept as a benchmark, not shipped
